displayPattern: Status LED: 8 short flashes then 3 long flashes (Infinity 25VNA8 heat pump and 24VNA9 air conditioner; amber status LED on the outdoor control)
meaning: Low pressure lockout for 4 hours, elevated from fault 32 after 3 occurrences.
causes: Low indoor airflow (cooling) or low outdoor airflow (heating)
Restriction in the filter drier, expansion device, circuits or tubing
diySteps: In cooling mode, check the indoor coil for clogging by ice or debris and clean or de-ice it if necessary (the manual also says to troubleshoot the indoor fan motor)
Check the outdoor coil for clogging by ice or debris and clean or de-ice it if necessary (the manual also says to troubleshoot the outdoor fan motor)
Technician: make sure the service valves are open; check charge with the manufacturer's charging method; troubleshoot the EXV/TXV and reversing valve; check for a restriction
safetyNote: Outdoor units carry line voltage even when the thermostat is off. Switch off the unit's disconnect and breaker before touching anything. Refrigerant, wiring, compressor and control-board work must be done by a licensed HVAC technician.
proAdvice: Call a licensed HVAC technician: lockout 83 involves refrigerant charge, valves and expansion devices.
sourceTitle: Carrier Infinity 25VNA8 heat pump / 24VNA9 air conditioner Service Manual (4SM)
